name: salesforce-agent-skills
description: Salesforce skills for AI coding agents. One builds and audits Flows with current elements (Filter, Transform with joins, choice sets, reactive screens, before-save, async and scheduled paths, event waits) instead of loop-and-decision patterns, with deploy-verified metadata examples, a checker, and an org-conventions file the team fills in. The other lists all automation on one object and the order it runs in.
